title: Apple touch icon
description: Transparent, with the rose enlarged to fill the area (Ricardo, 2026-11-25). He chose transparency knowingly: 'prefiero que no se vea el recuadro que implica ponerle otro fondo' — a visible box is worse than a slightly dimmer icon. MEASURED: iOS composites on black and loses only 1% of mean ink luminance (0.140 -> 0.138), because 33% of the frame is ink and 70% of that ink is already dark with the rose neon carrying the light. The earlier estimate of ~10% loss was too pessimistic. If it reads dim on device, the agreed remedy is raising the rose LUMINOSITY in this asset alone, not adding a background.
author: Ricardo (_00_) — transparency pass 2026-11-25
decision: transparent, no background; brighten ink if needed
